### RB Global, Inc. Declares Quarterly Dividend


July 24, 2026


- [Download (opens in new window)](https://s25.q4cdn.com/956353991/files/doc_news/RB-Global-Inc--Declares-Quarterly-Dividend-fcc76afc5-2026.pdf)


WESTCHESTER, Ill.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


RB Global, Inc. (NYSE and TSX: RBA) announces that on July 21, 2026 its Board of Directors declared a quarterly cash dividend of US$0.33 per common share, payable on September 17, 2026 to shareholders of record on August 25, 2026. This dividend is considered an eligible dividend for Canadian income tax purposes.


**About RB Global**


RB Global, Inc. (NYSE: RBA) (TSX: RBA) is a leading, omnichannel marketplace and trusted provider of value-added insights, services and transaction solutions for buyers and sellers of commercial assets and vehicles worldwide. Through its global network of auction sites and digital platform, RB Global serves customers worldwide across a variety of asset classes, including automotive, construction, commercial transportation, government surplus, lifting and material handling, energy, mining and agriculture. The company’s end-to-end marketplace solutions include[Ritchie Bros.](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.rbauction.com%2F%3F__hstc%3D152870310.9e0ab006fba8a5bb69a1a0bff3da7666.1683603843329.1687361271393.1687878803523.23%26__hssc%3D152870310.3.1687878803523%26__hsfp%3D771306454&esheet=54576393&newsitemid=20260724662459&lan=en-US&anchor=Ritchie+Bros.&index=1&md5=8213c3e0544ec97fd9112b6174911d88) ,[IAA](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fiaai.com%2F&esheet=54576393&newsitemid=20260724662459&lan=en-US&anchor=IAA&index=2&md5=905d795fdba6774576623a7574d3256b) ,[Rouse Services](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.rouseservices.com%2F&esheet=54576393&newsitemid=20260724662459&lan=en-US&anchor=Rouse+Services&index=3&md5=0406dfd68515074b01169654f415bf05) ,[SmartEquip](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.smartequip.com%2F&esheet=54576393&newsitemid=20260724662459&lan=en-US&anchor=SmartEquip&index=4&md5=5126565985f1dfb8396553a1a8f148fa) and[VeriTread](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.veritread.com%2F&esheet=54576393&newsitemid=20260724662459&lan=en-US&anchor=VeriTread&index=5&md5=ba9c31fc137e72bc7ebe32876c296063) . For more information about RB Global, visit[rbglobal.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.rbglobal.com%2F&esheet=54576393&newsitemid=20260724662459&lan=en-US&anchor=rbglobal.com&index=6&md5=4e1b39d7449589b5a25c76030040b4d3) .
